events.text_en: Úy Đan Dương of Hoa Cái Đường begins a nine-turn cinnabar elixir to carry a Trúc Cơ through Kết Đan, and calls it the Canopy Pill.
The eighth turn of the Canopy Pill blows back in the Hall's refining room; its founder is blinded, his partner Tôn Luyện Hà dies, and the Trúc Cơ La Tử Vi takes the furnace.
Thiên Xu leases the digging and washing of Thần Sa Khoáng to Hoa Cái Đường; the Pivot keeps the mine and buys back the refined cinnabar by weight at Thiên Quyền Thị.
